dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #I'm so happy right now! Are you happy too, {M#Mr. Honorary Knight}{F#Miss Honorary Knight}?

choices.text: It's always fun when we're with you, Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hooray! Let's keep playing hide-and-seek!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: The first time I saw this game, people were playing it on a table...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But I thought, what if we tried really acting like the characters in the game? So I told Albedo that idea.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And Albedo just happened to make these super magical things... hmm, what were they called again...? Oh yeah, alchemy gadgets! They're just like Whopperflowers!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: We put the gadgets all around the hide-and-seek area, and they can look like all sorts of little boxes. Then we can play using the same rules as the tabletop game!

choices.text: Klee and Albedo are so clever!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #I come to Dragonspine to see Albedo all the time, so I'm not afraid of the cold. But {M#Mr. Honorary Knight}{F#Miss Honorary Knight}, you have to be careful, okay? Don't catch a cold!

choices.text: Hooray! Hide-and-Seek is even cooler now!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! Some really strong-looking ladies came all the way from Natlan and gave me a special kind of storybook... It's called a comic!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: The people in the comics are all so cool! I want to draw comics about Mondstadt too...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Like... {M#Mr. Honorary Knight}{F#Miss Honorary Knight} going on a big treasure-hunting adventure with Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And stories about Mom and her friends too! Aunt Nicole, Aunt Barbie, and Aunt Octavia...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And then, my new friends, Yaoyao and Sayu, they both have really magical skills! They're amazing!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: There are so many fun things, I couldn't fit them all into even thousands of pages!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: But I can't get that effect with crayons... it seems like I need some special tools. I still have to learn some drawing techniques from Albedo!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Albedo's been working overtime... and he gets really tired, so I shouldn't make him even more tired...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: So when Albedo isn't busy anymore, I will go learn properly from him!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Oh, one more thing! Yoimiya came to visit too!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It's been so long since I last saw her, back when we went to Inazuma for that reading festival...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: When Yoimiya was passing by, I spotted her from super far away!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Then I showed her around Mondstadt, walking all over town and trying lots of yummy foods you can only get here!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I also wanted to take her fish blasting, but Master Jean said there are lots of foreign visitors in the city lately... and we can't scare them, or it might give Mondstadt a bad reputation!

choices.text: Klee did a great job being a good host!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hehe, there'll definitely be more chances to go fish-blasting later! I can be patient!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I really want to see Yoimiya's fireworks exploding over Cider Lake in the shape of goldfish!

choices.text: Klee's really growing up to be responsible! Big thumbs up!
Yeah, it really has been a while!
Klee's gonna be a great comic artist!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yay! I'll be waiting for you!
